[[File:IonTorpedoes-XWM.png|thumb|right|250px|An X-Wing firing ion torpedoes]]
An '''ion torpedo''' was a [[Torpedo/Legends|torpedo]] used in [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] [[Starfighter combat/Legends|combat]].

Capable of homing in on enemies, ion torpedos carried an intense [[Ion charge/Legends|ion charge]], and detonated in a powerful ion blast upon impacting a targeted ship. The blast was many times capable of crippling most [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]], being more powerful than [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] grade [[Ion cannon/Legends|ion cannons]].
